extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed replacement for automated mechanism placeholders; mechanism strength is bounded to source-located assays and limitations.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RH11 and comparator antimicrobial peptides in PAO1 membrane-integrity assay
mechanism_claims.claim_text: RH11 treatment caused rapid SYTOX-detected DNA release from P. aeruginosa PAO1, supporting membrane permeabilization linked to bacterial killing; inactive RH12 did not induce the same DNA release.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Fluorescence traces are figure-level; exact curve values were not digitized into additional quantitative rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM images of PAO1 exposed to RH11 showed membrane protrusions comparable to polymyxin B-treated cells, consistent with membrane disruption.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Image observations are qualitative; no figure-only exact counts were inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RH11 increased LPS aggregate size in DLS and induced carboxyfluorescein leakage from phosphatidylglycerol vesicles, supporting interaction with anionic membrane components.
direct_assay_types: dynamic light scattering LPS aggregation assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: DLS and CF leakage support membrane interaction but do not by themselves define a single molecular pore model.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RH11-treated B. subtilis and phosphatidylglycerol lipid vesicles
mechanism_claims.claim_text: AFM showed doughnut-like nanostructures after RH11 exposure to B. subtilis or phosphatidylglycerol vesicles, interpreted by the authors as lipid-peptide aggregate formation at membrane surfaces.
mechanism_claims.limitations: AFM was not satisfactory for P. aeruginosa, so this is supporting context from B. subtilis and lipid vesicles rather than a direct PAO1 AFM claim.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: fucosylated RH11 analogs in LecB crystal complexes
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Crystal structures of fucosylated RH11 analogs showed amphiphilic conformations with cationic lysines and hydrophobic residues arranged compatibly with membrane disruption.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structures are fucosylated analogs in LecB complexes, not a direct RH11-bacterial membrane structure.
